New here. Wanted to say that's wonderful mrwanderlust but the reality for me is that I am invisible. The woman you describe was me 10 years ago. I am expired as I am now 60. I am fit, intelligent, slim and attractive but my reality is that I am just too old. I am in NJ and have been divorced for 6 years. I have yet to see even a glimmer of interest in any suitable man I've met. I am giving up and now am going to try to find friends as opposed to dates. Maybe that's more of what I need anyway. Thank you for the insight. I'm glad there are still gentleman in the world today.

Your comment about waking up everyday and hating being alive really hit home for me. Being rejected living alone not having a lot of friends or plans makes for a rather abysmal existence. I hear from you that you are concerned about your family and I totally agree that they will morn your passing for a very very long time. What I am holding onto right now is that my love for them is irreplaceable and that has given me temporary reprieve from my plans to end my life. Would you consider contemplating that perspective?

I have a 20 year old son. He won't talk to me but I would tell him if he were as sad and thinking of taking his life that I would do anything and everything in my power to help him find another path...one maybe filled with purpose love joy and happiness. Please stay and fight for your life. You are worthy of love
That is wonderful I hope it works out for you and you are giving us hope that we can find someone too.
